name: youtube-hdr-cleaner
author: Rajot Das
description: YouTube HDR Cleaner: Chrome extension that fixes too-bright YouTube HDR videos by blocking HDR10, Dolby Vision and HLG streams or dimming them to SDR brightness

scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../youtube-hdr-cleaner-$npm_package_version.zip . && echo "Packaged youtube-hdr-cleaner-$npm_package_version.zip"
